title: AAPS After database reset: loop process blocks, app crashes on manual calculation (tab SMB/AUTOISF - swipe)
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.3.0-dev-c**
Flavor: fullDebug
Build commit# ba1c475fcce4a7275e21d5be3799aefb5771e0b6

Problem is when config is set to OpenAPS SMB or AutoISF
When selecting OpenAPS AMA all seems well

*After database reset:*
- Loop stops, no APS/algo calculations on SBM/AutoISF tab
- App crashes when APS calculation is forced by manual swipe on this tab

**Additional info:**
Just before crashing AAPS briefly shows the "Fallback to SMB. Not enough TDD data". Also seeing the alert "Fallback to profile sensitivity. Not enough TDD data".
This is even after 6++ hours...

*Logfile:*
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17384814/AndroidAPS.log)
